name: claro-ai
description: Claro, Casafari's business expansion search agent: commercial premises and plots in Spain and Germany from a brief in plain words, each criterion met, not met or not stated with its evidence, plus Location Intelligence.

interface.longDescription: Describe the site a business needs in plain words, in any language, and Claro finds the commercial premises for rent or sale across Spain and Germany that meet it: shops, restaurant premises, offices, warehouses. Every result says which criteria it meets, does not meet or does not state, with the sentence or figure behind each answer, plus Location Intelligence: footfall, residents, spending power and places nearby. Also commercial plots in Germany. Built by Casafari, the AI agent-native real estate data intelligence platform.
defaultPrompt: Find street-level premises for a café in Barcelona, 60-120 m², with a smoke outlet, under €4,000 a month
Compare the footfall around three premises in Madrid
Find gym premises in Valencia with no gym within 500 m
